verdict.rationale: Supabase's own marketing says every project is "a full Postgres database" (supabase-docs-51, supabase-docs-31), and a community user treats it as a hosted SQL offering they use directly (supabase-comm-4). That implies the database is reachable by standard Postgres tooling, but nothing in the pack documents a connection string, direct connection, or ORM integration. missing for 10: documented connection strings (direct and pooled), connection pooling details, ORM/standard-client integration guides, hands-on corroboration of connecting with external clients.
